facts.fact: ENA reported that the draft Electronic Signature regulation is a step toward fully operationalizing Proclamation No. 1072/2017 (and its amendment), the existing electronic signature law.

The Council of Ministers unanimously approved the Electronic Signature regulation under Proclamation No. 1072/2017, to take effect on publication in the Federal Negarit Gazette; the report does not say it has been published.

facts.fact: Digital Policy Alert states that the June 2020 Electronic Transactions Proclamation set cybersecurity requirements for e-commerce platforms, including secure data transmission and storage.

note: The Electronic Transactions Proclamation is only said to have been developed; its standing is not stated.
An e-signature amendment, not an e-commerce law; it only lets the Council of Ministers and INSA issue regulations and directives.
All four lines are policies or strategies, which this study does not assess.
